meta.title: Make a Mark Brussels
meta.description: A one-day make-a-thon where creative makers and Brussels social organisations work together on communication, design, and digital challenges. Join the 2027 edition.

hero.headline: Design and creativity are for everyone
hero.intro: Volunteer makers and Brussels social organisations team up for one day to work on communication, design and digital challenges.

makers.heading: Info for Makers

steps.title: Friday evening
steps.text: We all come together to plan and get to know each other. To make sure everyone can go in turbo creative mode Saturday.

steps.title: All day Saturday
steps.text: You'll spend the whole of Saturday collaborating in a team, tackling a creative challenge for the central case. We'll provide WiFi, food, drinks, and great company to keep you energized throughout the day.

steps.title: Selected in advance
steps.text: We select Makers in advance, ensuring we form the most effective teams to tackle the challenges. We'll let you know at the end of January if you got selected. A few weeks after that you'll meet your team members and the organisation to discuss their challenge, in a one-hour meeting on an evening in the first week of March.

makers.closing: Please make sure you can make it.

about.heading: The people behind Make a Mark
about.intro: Make a Mark Brussels is part of the global Make a Mark movement. The local team brings volunteer makers and social organisations together for a day of shared creative work.
